observations.claim: Separate preprocessor/compiler/assembler/linker products and missing-symbol link rejection
Frozen .i retains old generated macro despite fresh source/header inputs
Generated header selection is consumed at preprocessing, not downstream compilation
Actual GCC link subprocess reconstructed for PIE and static, with selected startup/library inputs
Static changes runtime closure; PIE changes loader and image assumptions
Assembly _start establishes call alignment, passes argument and exits through Linux syscall; no CRT supplied
Resolved startup/library hashes, search paths and specific missing-local-library rejection
Tool-specific warning and C17 constraint are separate; signed-overflow reasoning is assessor-only
GCC and Clang diagnostic classes checked without depending on complete prose
Valid control, language diagnostic, missing header, missing compiler and link-only failure classified distinctly
Compile-only link-negative is accepted as a translation but rejected at final link
Region and TU-local suppressions preserve unrelated diagnostics
Target-local suppression cannot suppress a separately compiled TU
GCC/Clang O0/O2/Os sums n=0..16 agree with independent integer oracle; disassembly and size retained
Six isolated effective-flag configurations, active NDEBUG control, host-only coverage/sanitizer dependencies
Coverage links its own host runtime; target closure is not inferred
Actual sum+1024-byte copy object/final closure for O0/O2/Os/LTO/sanitizer/coverage; bitcode reader explicit
Custom-entry stack protection requires support symbol and initialized guard contract; bare link refuses missing support
